Monetary Policy Report

Monetary Policy Report, 5 May 2026

Economic growth in Norway is moderate, and inflation has declined markedly from the peak.

The Norwegian economy

GDP growth is expected to be 1.5 per cent in 2026. The mainland economy is expected to grow by 1.1 per cent in 2026.

Inflation

CPI inflation is projected to average 2.6 per cent in 2027. Underlying inflation is expected to be 3.4 per cent in 2026.

The labour market

Unemployment is expected to be 3.1 per cent in 2026. Wage growth is projected to be 3.9 per cent in 2026.

Policy rate path

The policy rate is set at 1.75 per cent in 2028.

Risks and uncertainty

The risks to the economic outlook are tilted to the upside. Uncertainties surrounding international growth are considerable.

Monetary policy

The policy rate will be kept at a tight level for an extended period. The Committee is prepared to adjust the policy rate if the outlook changes.
